data.name: Levantera: Tale of The Winds
data.detailed_description:
Get ready to set sail! You are the captain of the M.S. Tradewind, a trade ship bound for the open sea!
Gather your crew, test your sea readiness, and explore the world in this 8-bit action/RPG inspired by NES classics.
Featuring a persistent world, a robust story, and a full musical score in chiptune style!

In Levantera, use your combat skill and agility to battle by land and sea in both platforming sections and overworld ship combat.
Quick swap main and sub weapons to suit your play style. Gather your crew from taverns and upgrade your ship to face tougher opponents.
Conquer the spellbook and use the silver compass to quick-select your favorite spells.

Prepare to discover exotic locations and encounter fierce combatants as you travel the world in search of your lost former crew.
Action, adventure, and enchantment await as you uncover the secrets of the arcane force of the wind: Levantera.

reviews.review:
Developed and published by Lasso Games, Levantera: Tale of The Winds is a retro-inspired action RPG that embraces the spirit of classic 8-bit adventures while introducing enough modern ideas to keep the experience from feeling like a simple imitation. From the moment players assume the role of the captain of the M.S. Tradewind, the game sets out to deliver a seafaring adventure built around exploration, mystery, and progression. Its nostalgic pixel art, lively chiptune soundtrack, and old-school presentation immediately establish the tone, but beneath its familiar appearance lies an ambitious blend of action, role-playing, and naval exploration that strives to offer more depth than many retro-inspired indie titles.

The adventure revolves around exploring a large world divided between dangerous oceans and diverse islands waiting to be discovered. Sailing across the sea is much more than simply moving between locations, as players must recruit crew members from taverns, strengthen their ship, and prepare for encounters that become increasingly demanding as the journey unfolds. The search for a missing crew serves as the central narrative, gradually introducing larger mysteries surrounding the magical force known as Levantera. This steady progression encourages curiosity, rewarding players who take time to investigate hidden areas, complete optional objectives, and uncover secrets scattered throughout the game's interconnected world.

Combat combines fast-paced action with a satisfying amount of flexibility. Players can equip different primary and secondary weapons, allowing them to adapt their approach depending on the enemies they encounter. Magic further expands combat options through a growing collection of spells accessed with the aid of a spellbook and magical compass, giving encounters additional variety beyond simple swordplay. Alongside battles on land, naval gameplay introduces another layer to the adventure, requiring players to manage their vessel while engaging in ship-to-ship encounters and boarding actions. Inventory management, quest tracking, character progression, and crew recruitment all contribute to making the experience feel like a complete action RPG instead of a straightforward platforming adventure.

Visually, Levantera succeeds in capturing the charm of classic console games without feeling outdated. Its pixel environments are colorful and detailed, while character sprites feature enough personality to make exploration enjoyable. The soundtrack complements every stage of the adventure with energetic chiptune compositions that reinforce the nostalgic atmosphere. Together, the visuals and music create a presentation that feels authentic to the era that inspired it while remaining polished enough to satisfy modern players who appreciate retro aesthetics.

Since the game is presented in Early Access, it naturally comes with unfinished elements that prospective players should keep in mind. Although the current version already includes its primary gameplay systems, core story content, exploration mechanics, and progression features, the developers have been transparent about ongoing work involving bug fixes, expanded side content, improved naval combat, additional lore, and further magical abilities. The foundation already demonstrates considerable ambition, but the overall experience still benefits from continued refinement before reaching its full potential.

Levantera: Tale of The Winds stands out because of its willingness to combine several gameplay styles into a single adventure. Rather than focusing exclusively on combat or platforming, it successfully mixes exploration, ship management, role-playing progression, magic, and naval travel into an experience that consistently encourages players to venture farther into its world. While some rough edges remain due to its Early Access status, the game's strong sense of adventure, appealing retro presentation, and ambitious design make it an enjoyable journey for fans of classic action RPGs who appreciate exploration and old-school gameplay philosophy.

Rating: 6/10
